reason: NB1 E1/E2/E3 were discovered to measure F4_SOURCE_FIELD, the eight-view source-silhouette intersection field, rather than the learned IRIS field. Their R512 Stage13/extractor results therefore cannot establish learned-field fidelity or learned-field extractor ownership.

The existing learned IRIS R256 zero-surface is far below Stage13-v2 thresholds on overlapping source-correctness metrics; a frozen learned-field R512 measurement is the cheapest direct test of whether this is primarily dense-sampling error or learned-field error.

The full-domain learned-field UNKNOWN population also contains a large source-external region. Running X7 before learned-field fidelity and SOURCE_ABSENT versus FIELD_UNKNOWN separation would mix field quality, product-domain qualification and bound-productivity questions.
required_before_x7: VF11 learned-field R512 primary fidelity gate under the frozen Stage13-v2 policy, with no visual-hull clipping or mesh repair before measurement
X6D source-support domain diagnostic with explicit silhouette dilation/calibration tolerance and SOURCE_ABSENT semantics
learned-field aligned-lattice near-surface certificate audit, independent of the source visual-hull mesh
direct LayerNorm interval-variance instrumentation, including comparison to the projected-generator norm lower bound, on a spatial/certifiability stratified sample
numeric_rigor_note: Current CPU confirmation and CUDA screening both use ordinary float64 rather than directed rounding. CPU replay is a cross-implementation/device consistency check, not a formal strengthening of the numerical certificate. GPU authority is forbidden until an end-to-end outward enclosure covers all arithmetic, reductions, LayerNorm nonlinearities, and SiLU residual calculations.
